name: BR-2 "Purgatory Camo" Shotgun
description: Originally designed for the military, Behring decided to sell the BR-2 ballistic shotgun to the general public after the initial weapon testers kept requesting to take one home. Featuring a semi-auto fire mode that can rapidly deliver devastating stopping power, the BR-2 is the ideal choice for both offensive and defensive operations. The Purgatory Camo edition's grey-on-grey dressing creates a sleek, utilitarian profile.
